source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster correction sheet supplies three distinct replacement construction frames; the approved ink, color, and finished masters remain unchanged.
source.notes: Step 1 must stay sparse, Step 2 must add the complete shell and screen structure, and Step 3 must install every control and hardware detail before the preserved black-marker frame. Keep one face-free unbranded handheld console in a stable three-quarter front view with a blank screen, one D-pad, exactly two action buttons, two menu buttons, four speaker slots, one power light, and one broken shadow.

process_strategy: Begin with only a pale tilted center axis, loose front-face envelope, screen footprint, side-thickness offset, control centers, speaker baseline, and shadow footprint; add the complete rounded shell, visible right-side thickness, and raised blank-screen bezel in Step 2; install the D-pad, two action buttons, two menu buttons, four speaker slots, power light, two screen highlights, and refined shadow in Step 3; then preserve the approved ink, color, and finish frames unchanged.

final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes a tilted center axis, loose rounded front-face envelope, screen footprint, right-side thickness offset, D-pad center, two action-button centers, two menu-button centers, speaker baseline, power-light center, and broken shadow footprint without drawing finished controls or shell contours.

final_elements.description: One complete chunky handheld shell with rounded corners, a raised blank-screen bezel, and a visible right-side thickness plane while all hardware remains only pale placement marks.

final_elements.description: A face-free control layout with one cross-shaped D-pad, exactly two round action buttons, exactly two small oval menu buttons, exactly four short speaker slots, one power light, two diagonal blank-screen highlight gaps, and the complete broken shadow outline.

final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces all established shell, bezel, control, speaker, light, highlight, and shadow boundaries.

final_elements.description: A limited retro palette fills the established shell, controls, blank screen, power light, and shadow with visible marker streaks and open paper highlights.

rejection_checks: Keep one face-free handheld console, one three-quarter front view, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.

Step 1 must remain a sparse perspective scaffold, Step 2 must visibly add the complete shell and screen structure, and Step 3 must visibly add the controls and hardware; reject any repair where these frames read as the same drawing with darker lines.
The blank screen, D-pad, two action buttons, two menu buttons, four speaker slots, power light, and side thickness must remain in the same positions after they appear.
Do not introduce a control, slot, light, bezel edge, screen highlight, shadow shape, or color area in the final panel.
Do not add game characters, pixels, words, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, hands, cables, cartridges, face features, sticker borders, or badge frames.
The screen must stay blank apart from the two established diagonal paper-highlight gaps.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean icon art, polished product rendering, or glossy AI poster art.
